messages:
Sophie Chen: urgent - a group of APAC trial accounts are seeing repeated auth failures when onboarding via SSO after last night's policy change. need a short customer note and an internal triage plan.
Liam Patel: can we revert quickly? auth failures = big renewal risk.
Anya Kuznetsova: root cause initial: an optional header introduced in the new SSO proxy caused some SAML assertions to fail validation for tenants with legacy IdP configs. Mitigation: rolled back proxy change and requeued failed onboarding jobs. We're running a job to re-onboard affected tenants; ETA ~2 hours for most.
Carlos Rivera: drafting customer-facing copy: "Hi - we experienced SSO onboarding interruptions for some tenants in APAC due to a configuration change; we rolled back the change and requeued jobs. If you continue to see issues, reply and we'll assist. We
are offering a one-time credit for affected accounts." Thoughts?
Grace Li: add quick support steps: confirm tenant's IdP is in updated format, or ask CS to open a support ticket if they need us to re-run onboarding.
statusbot: Incident updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rdw-apac-sso-2026 - rollback applied, requeues in progress.
Sophie Chen: send the note to the 45 affected accounts and flag trials with renewals in 60 days.
Liam Patel: renewals will handle outreach for those flagged.
Anya Kuznetsova: will prepare a short RCA for customers explaining the header compatibility issue and next steps for IdP config guidance.
Sophie Chen: thanks team.
